subject: Intro Python Turtle
arc_note: Grade 3 FIRST typed code, BUT every sheet centres on a for-loop (repeating events) — the G3 rubric caps a no-loop sheet at C1-L2, so 'meet forward()' alone can't pass. Pedagogically fine: students just did loops in Block Coding; Turtle shows the SAME loop in TYPED code (the block→text bridge = the C3-L4 path reserved for this subject). Angles are GIVEN (copy-this), never derived. solution.py MODELS the turtle path (x,y,heading) and asserts the figure — 'executes clean' via the model, no GUI.

topics.title: Meet Python Turtle
topics.concept: first typed code is a loop: for step in range(n): bit.forward() — repeat block → for-loop bridge

topics.title: Turning in Code
topics.concept: a for-loop with forward + right(given angle) inside — repeated move+turn

topics.title: Draw a Square with a Loop

topics.title: Change the Shape
topics.concept: change range() count + the given angle to draw a triangle/hexagon (read & alter, C3.2)

topics.title: Loop a Pattern in Code
topics.concept: a for-loop that repeats steps to make a staircase/row pattern

topics.title: Read the Turtle Code

topics.title: Fix the Turtle Code
